question.text: GST is applicable on which of the following components of trading costs in ETIRD?

answer.text: Brokerage, exchange charges, and other service charges

explanation.text: The Logic: GST is applicable on brokerage, exchange transaction charges, clearing charges, and other service charges related to ETIRD trading. These are services subject to the standard GST rate (currently 18%). The Trap: ETIRD is NOT GST exempt. While STT doesn't apply, GST applies to all service components. The GST adds to the total cost of trading. Cross-Exam Context: Understanding total trading costs (including GST) is tested in Series IV and is important for calculating the true cost of hedging or trading strategies. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Total ETIRD trading costs include: brokerage + exchange charges + clearing charges + SEBI regulatory fees + GST on all the above + stamp duty. Factor all of these when evaluating hedge economics.
